title: In bulk mode a row click ticks it, the header box ticks or clears all
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Parts -> Inventory page on the build under test, with permission to view inventory parts.
  2. You hold the "Part Library & Inventory - Delete" permission (needed to change status/tracking).
  3. Seed a few inventory parts (tag throwaway data "ZZAUTOTEST", e.g. part number "ZZAUTOTEST-PKG-1", name "ZZAUTOTEST package part") via New Inventory Part. Turn Deactivate parts on.
custom_steps:
1. Click anywhere on a row and confirm it ticks (not opens); click again to untick.
  2. Click the header checkbox and confirm every currently loaded row ticks; click again to clear.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • While the mode is on, clicking anywhere on a row ticks or unticks that row instead of opening the part.
  • The header checkbox ticks or clears every row currently loaded in the list.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; "Parts Lifecycle Update" PRD (Confluence 829227015, IN REVIEW 2026-09-09), Story 2 (Deactivate parts); design canvas Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026 against an IN-REVIEW spec; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R5: “While the mode is on, clicking anywhere on a row ticks or unticks that row instead of opening the part.”
  • S2-R6: “The checkbox in the header ticks or clears every row currently loaded in the list.”
